visualizerParams.title: Bug Squasher: List items outside the list
visualizerParams.problemDescription: A screen reader announces this list as having two items. The last item was written after the closing tag of the list, so it is not part of it.

solution.explanation: An li only belongs to a list when it sits between the opening and closing tag of ul or ol. Outside it, the browser shows the text without a bullet and screen readers do not count it as part of the list.

checks.label: All three items are inside the list
